autoplay.label: Autoplay
autoplay.help: Start playback automatically after the video is ready.

loop.label: Loop playback
loop.help: Start over instead of stopping at the end.

frameWindow.label: Match the window to the video
frameWindow.help: On, opening a video gives the window the frame's shape. In immersive mode the picture reaches the window edges.

exportDir.label: Export location
exportDir.help: Folder exported frames are written to. Empty saves beside the source video.

settings.label: 自动播放
settings.help: 视频准备好后自动开始播放。

settings.label: 循环播放
settings.help: 播完从头继续，而不是停在结尾。

settings.label: 窗口对齐视频
settings.help: 打开视频时按画面比例调整窗口；沉浸模式下画面贴住窗口边缘。

settings.label: 导出位置
settings.help: 导出帧保存到哪个文件夹；留空保存到源视频所在目录。
